title: The pro-etale sheaf exceptional-image construction
statement:
Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$ be a
closed immersion
with complementary open immersion $j$, and let $A$ be a
finite commutative ring. For a
pro-etale module sheaf
$N$ on $T$, set

$$
i^!_0N=i^*\ker\bigl(N\longrightarrow j_*j^*N\bigr).
$$

The map in this formula is the unit of the open
inverse-image and
direct-image adjunction. A morphism of sheaves induces a
map of these kernels and then its closed inverse image;
this specifies the functor on morphisms. No adjunction or
constructibility property is part of this construction.

lean.note: §1(B), second reading against the current base: the recorded ProEtale.finiteSupportedSections/finiteClosedUpperShriek in Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtaleSupportedSections act on fixed-scalar ModuleCat-valued sheaves. They do not accept the intrinsic SheafOfModules objects of the published proEtaleDerivedCategory and sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero interfaces used here. This module supplies the same canonical unit-kernel and closed module inverse image in that intrinsic presentation, using the published arbitrary-ring operations and uniquely tensor-unit-normalized adjunction. The formerly recorded legacy closed-support module also conflicts with the finite-coefficient star imports. No new site, coefficient object, or arbitrary map is introduced.
